shortDescription: This module starts or stops remote copies on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: access
options.description: Instructs the system to allow write access to a consistent secondary volume. Applies when I(state=stopped).

options.name: clean
options.description: Specifies that the volume that is to become a secondary is clean. Applies when I(state=started).

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: force
options.description: Specifies that the system must process the copy operation even if it causes a temporary loss of consistency during synchronization. Applies when I(state=started).

options.name: isgroup
options.description: Specifies that a consistency group has to be started or stopped.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a name to assign to the new remote copy relationship or group, or to operate on the existing remote copy.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: primary
options.description: Specifies the copy direction by defining which disk becomes the primary (source). Applies when I(state=started).

options.name: state
options.description: Starts (C(started)) or stops (C(stopped)) a remote copy relationship.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
